places.name: Great Mosque of Kairouan
places.ai_summary: A UNESCO World Heritage Site, the Great Mosque of Kairouan is a masterpiece of Islamic architecture, showcasing centuries of history and culture.

opening_hours.notes: Closed during prayer times on Fridays.

places.place_tip: Wear modest clothing and visit early to avoid crowds.
places.address: Rue de la Kasbah, Kairouan, Tunisia

wikimedia_commons.source_file: File:3D computer modeling of the Great mosquee of Kairouan-en.svg

attribution.title: 3D computer modeling of the Great mosquee of Kairouan-en
attribution.author: Tachymètre (talk)
attribution.credit: Modeled in 6 days using SolidWorks 2001. Post-production in Photoshop and Inkscape. Based on architectural plans and fifty photos of the building.
attribution.description: Three-dimensional views of the Great Mosque of Kairouan, Tunisia. From left to right: zoom on the south wall (seen from the outside), global view of the mosque, zoom on the minaret seen from the court.

places.name: Medina of Kairouan
places.ai_summary: The Medina of Kairouan is a UNESCO World Heritage site, known for its well-preserved medieval architecture and vibrant souks.

opening_hours.notes: Some shops may close during prayer times.

places.place_tip: Don't miss the opportunity to shop for local handicrafts.

places.name: Aghlabid Basins
places.ai_summary: The Aghlabid Basins are an impressive example of medieval hydraulic engineering, providing a glimpse into the advanced technology of the Aghlabid period.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the cooler months.

places.place_tip: Combine your visit with the Great Mosque, as they are close to each other.

attribution.credit: originally posted to Flickr as 004758

places.name: Mosque of the Three Doors
places.ai_summary: This mosque is famous for its three intricately carved doors, representing a fine example of Islamic art and architecture.

opening_hours.notes: Closed during prayer times.

places.place_tip: Take time to admire the detailed carvings on the doors.

places.name: Barber’s Mosque (Zaouia of Sidi Sahab)
places.ai_summary: This mosque is dedicated to a famous barber and is an important pilgrimage site, featuring unique architectural elements.

opening_hours.notes: Respect the prayer times and dress modestly.

places.place_tip: Look out for the unique architectural features influenced by the barber's profession.

places.name: Dar Hassine Allani Museum
places.ai_summary: This museum offers a deep dive into the history and culture of Kairouan, housed in a beautiful traditional building.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available in multiple languages.

places.place_tip: Join a guided tour for in-depth knowledge about the exhibits.

places.name: Bir Barouta Well
places.ai_summary: A historical well known for its unique architecture and the legend of its infinite depth.

opening_hours.notes: The well is located in a quiet area, ideal for reflection.

places.place_tip: Bring a coin to throw in the well for good luck, as per the local tradition.

places.name: Kairouan Carpet Workshops
places.ai_summary: Kairouan is famous for its carpets, and these workshops offer a glimpse into the traditional carpet-making process.

opening_hours.notes: Workshops may close during prayer times.

places.place_tip: Ask about the different types of carpets and the stories behind them.

places.name: Kairouan Medina Market
places.ai_summary: A bustling market located in the heart of the Medina, offering a wide variety of local products and handicrafts.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited in the morning for the freshest products.

places.place_tip: Bargain for the best prices and try to learn a few words of Arabic.

places.name: Kairouan Archaeological Museum
places.ai_summary: The museum houses a rich collection of artifacts from the ancient city of Kairouan, providing insight into its storied past.

opening_hours.notes: Guided tours are available in multiple languages.

places.place_tip: Check out the museum shop for unique souvenirs.

places.name: Old City Walls
places.ai_summary: The ancient walls of Kairouan, offering a glimpse into the city's historical fortifications and stunning views from the top.

opening_hours.notes: Wear comfortable shoes for walking on the walls.

places.place_tip: Bring water and a hat, as it can be hot and sunny.

places.name: Aghlabid Palace Ruins
places.ai_summary: The ruins of the Aghlabid Palace, showcasing the remnants of the once-magnificent structure and its historical significance.

opening_hours.notes: The site is not very touristy, offering a peaceful visit.

places.place_tip: Explore the area around the ruins for a complete experience.

places.name: Rue du 7 Novembre Souk
places.ai_summary: A vibrant souk (market) street in Kairouan, offering a variety of local products, spices, and souvenirs.

opening_hours.notes: The souk is closed on Sundays.

places.place_tip: Try the local street food available in the souk.

places.ai_summary: A significant religious site in Kairouan, known for its beautiful architecture and serene atmosphere.

opening_hours.notes: Respect the religious practices and dress modestly.

places.place_tip: Visit the nearby areas for a complete experience of Kairouan's religious heritage.

places.ai_summary: A scenic walk along the ancient gates of the Medina, offering insights into the historical fortifications of Kairouan.

opening_hours.notes: Wear comfortable shoes and bring water.

places.place_tip: Combine this walk with a visit to the nearby attractions.

places.ai_summary: A viewpoint offering panoramic views of Kairouan and its surroundings, ideal for photography and sightseeing.

opening_hours.notes: Best visited during the day for the views.

places.place_tip: Bring binoculars for a closer view of the distant landmarks.

places.name: Local Pottery Market
places.ai_summary: A local market specializing in traditional Tunisian pottery, offering a variety of colors, shapes, and sizes.

opening_hours.notes: The market is closed on Sundays.

places.place_tip: Look for unique pieces and consider buying directly from the artisans.

opening_hours.notes: Respect the religious significance of the site.

places.place_tip: Explore the surrounding area for a complete experience.
